items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment. Reject new spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, and unsupported revenue claims. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The aggregate row is not site-attributable; reported site-attributed commission is $0, which does not prove zero site performance. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost windows do not align. AI-cost records also conflict: $881.36 across 4,832 calls for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27 versus retained $973.35 across 5,439 calls. Infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, approved-budget, experiment-cost, and defined learning-outcome records are absent or incomplete. Continue only existing period-aligned attribution and cost reconciliation; do not create duplicate telemetry or financial work.

Minimum measurement required: period-aligned site/content revenue tied to verified tracking IDs; ordered and shipped status; reconciled AI, infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, and experiment costs; approved budgets and commitments; and a defined learning outcome with incremental cost. Do not treat impressions, rankings, clicks, sessions, conversions, ordered items, performance scores, or AI usage as financial returns without attributable revenue or documented cost savings.

Support containment-only execution. Preserve the existing measurement and attribution reconciliation work item, retain the aggregate $4.92 as unattributed, and keep margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, budget capacity, and causal lift unknown. No new proposals, change requests, experiments, deployments, spending, commitments, or monetization changes are financially supported.
